capabilities: Open an editor by right-clicking embedded images, from the file manager, or via the command palette
Annotate images with pen, line, arrow, rectangle, ellipse, text, and mosaic tools
Crop images with rule-of-thirds guides and adjustable handles
Overwrite the original image or save edits as a new PNG file
Rewrite vault links when non-PNG images are converted to PNG
extras: README is bilingual (English and Chinese) with manual installation steps and implementation notes; the manifest states the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian can display images but offers no built-in way to annotate or crop them without leaving the vault for an external editor.
summary: In-place image editor that opens from a right-click on embedded images to annotate, crop, and mosaic, then replaces the original file.
